description: Bornes de recharge électrique is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville du Havre. Location of electric charging stations Data generated automatically by geoprocessing that uses data from parking spaces and data from track sections. Coverage: Ville du Havre. The portal shows the English title as "Electric charging stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville du Havre. Its keywords include rechargement, havraise, ouvertes, lagglomeration, maritime, vehicule. The listing shows 5 download or service links in KMZ, SHP, DXF, JSON. The listing shows 2024-04-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
